messages:
alex_partners: Heads-up: marketplace "soft launch" dry run Friday 09:30am PT. Goal: validate partner SKU mappings across cloud marketplaces, confirm press amplify schedule, and run a DNS/CDN cutover rehearsal. Who can own DNS rollback?
nina_mkt: I'll run the press cadence and partner social schedule. Drafts posted in the doc, will need final logo lock + legal copy by Thu 5pm PT.
tom_infra: I can own DNS rollback steps. We'll keep previous cname (v1.redwood.ai) as fallback and pre-stage TTL changes. Will post cutover checklist.
luis_hw: Hardware partners (EdgeCorp & NimbleEdge) noted a mismatch: EdgeCorp has two SKUs per config but our listing system expects one-to-one. Need a mapping strategy.
priya.p: For SKU mapping we can support parent SKU -> child SKUs as metadata. I can add a shim in the staging listing importer to accept a CSV with parent_id and child_ids. ETA Thu noon.
jessica_si: SI smoke kit ready, will run through integration checklist after staging deploy. Need sample cloud marketplace purchase webhook payloads to validate billing sync.
ops-bot: FYI staging surge scheduled Thu 3pm PT: simulating marketplace traffic + 15% spike for 15 minutes. Monitor queues.
deploy-bot: mktplace-staging-deploy started by @tom_infra at 2025-11-06T08:10:00Z.
samg: Great. Jessica, I'll drop example webhook bodies. Also remind partners about embargo. Nina: what's go/no-go criteria from marketing?
nina_mkt: Go if: (1) partner logos locked & legal ok, (2) microsite renders in <600ms 95th, (3) purchase + webhook flow completes end-to-end with SI, (4) monitoring alerts configured. Else hold.
legal-bot: Notice: partner legal confirmed trademark lines for EdgeCorp; NimbleEdge still pending variant approval. Please tag @legal-bot once final assets are uploaded.
luis_hw: NimbleEdge will provide final assets by Thu 4pm PT. EdgeCorp wants the condensed mark and a high-res PNG.
priya.p: I uploaded a sample mapping CSV to /staging/assets/sku-mapping.csv. Format: vendor, parent_sku, child_skus (pipe-delimited). Example: EdgeCorp,EC-BOX-2000,EC-BOX-2000-A|EC-BOX-2000-B

jessica_si: Sample webhook payloads (posted):
``n{
  "event":"purchase.completed",
  "vendor":"EdgeCorp",
  "sku":"EC-BOX-2000-A",
  "order_id":"ORD-8892",
  "region":"eu-west-1",
  "billing_ref":"BILL-123"
}
``n
I'll validate that our billing lambda consumes and posts to SI tenant.

samg: Tom, can you paste rollover procedure for CDN invalidation? We need to know how long cache TTL changes might take.

tom_infra: CDN invalidation steps: (1) create invalidation request for /marketplace/*, (2) set short TTL via origin override for 30m, (3) monitor edge hit ratio. Rollback: revert origin override and re-issue invalidation with previous cache key. Command: `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id XXXXXX --paths "/marketplace/*"`
lina_check: (typo) sorry ignore

ops-bot: Alert rule reminder: marketplace-5xx-rate increase -> page SRE if >3% sustained for 5m.

alex_partners: We also need to align the partner badges (Marketplace Certified) with partner criteria. Decision: only SI partners that completed integration + 3 customers in beta get badge. Jessica, confirm SI beta list?
jessica_si: Confirmed list shared in the SI doc. I'll run the badge check after SI tests pass.

nina_mkt: Publish timing: target 09:40am PT. Partners to amplify at +2m and +10m. We plan two posts: short announcement + technical deep-dive blog. Need CTA links for partner pages.

priya.p: Microsite preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace-preview (password protected). I'll open access for partners Thu 6pm PT for approval.
samg: Who's monitoring for rollout window Friday? Ben? (not in thread) If not, I'll be reachable.
tom_infra: I'll watch deploy and DNS. Add me to rota.

luis_hw: Quick question: does the listing page display child SKUs or the parent? UX prefers showing parent with expand for child configs. Priya can we support that?
priya.p: Yes, frontend will show parent with accordion for child variants. Will use the child_ids field from the importer.

jessica_si: After staging surge and webhook validation I'll post a short smoke summary with timestamps. If anything fails, we abort cutover and revert DNS TTL to previous value.

alex_partners: Final action items:
- Priya: finalize importer + frontend variant UX (Thu noon).
- Tom: post DNS/CND cutover + rollback doc (Thu EOD).
- Nina: finalize press + partner social calendar (Thu 5pm).
- Jessica: SI smoke + webhook validation (Thu after staging surge).
- Luis: collect final HW assets (Thu 4pm).
- Legal-bot: final copy confirmation (Thu 5pm).

samg: Thanks — will run go/no-go call Fri 08:50am PT. Please ping here with any blockers. :rocket:
